p1.aim: 最小変更・ポーズ調整
p1.style: clear, precise, at a measured pace, without dragging Keep pauses between phrases brief and natural, letting the explanation flow smoothly.

p2.style: Clear and precise, at a slightly slower than conversational pace. Keep the explanation flowing naturally, with brief pauses.

p3.style: Clear, precise, at a measured pace, without dragging. Connect the words and phrases naturally, with no unnecessary breaks.

p4.aim: 自然な英語教師の説明
p4.style: Explain clearly and naturally, like a patient English teacher speaking to a learner. Use a slightly relaxed pace and smooth phrasing.

p5.aim: 理解に必要な短い間だけを許容
p5.style: Clear and easy to follow, at a gently measured pace. Use only short, natural pauses where they help understanding.

p6.aim: 一文としての滑らかさ
p6.style: Clear, precise, and gently paced. Deliver the explanation as one smooth, connected thought, without stretching the spaces between phrases.

p7.aim: 速度・リズムのバランス型
p7.style: Speak clearly at a slightly relaxed, natural pace. Keep a steady rhythm, with brief transitions between phrases and no drawn-out pauses.
